critical_code_review_comments: library.py: _localize_book_detail() is defined but never wired into the GET /api/library/books/{slug} handler. Detail-page i18n today relies solely on the frontend AutoText flush (which already works per iter58 + iter59 regression). If you want the same fast-cached server-side path for detail (eliminating the AutoText burst on chapter list), call `await _localize_book_detail(db, out)` right before returning from get_book.

The first request per language is slow (~5-10s of LLM batches per endpoint). For best UX on cold-start, consider warming books/radio/films for it+es at app boot or via a background task; cache then serves instantly.

rca_of_issue: iter58 had two root causes — both fixed in iter59: (A) Three <Text> nodes (dietary chip + 2 admin links) bypassed AutoText. Fixed by replacing them with <AutoText>. (B) The bulk Library catalog (~50+ strings) was slow because AutoText flushed lazily per-screen. Fixed by adding _localize_docs() in library.py which runs the title/blurb (and station name) through the permanently-cached translate_texts based on the Accept-Language ContextVar, so list responses are pre-translated server-side. First request per language is still LLM-bound (~5-10s) but every subsequent request is instant from cache.
